entry.name: live.adsrui
entry.description: The live.adsrui object is a user interface for defining the shape of an envelope using the classic Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release model. Each segment has an individually definable length and exponential slope. This object is designed to work seamlessly with its companion object, live.adsr~.
